Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Anil - 30 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Meenakshi - 62 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Anita - 27 years, princess, daughter
Look: small crown, pink lehenga
4. Sanjay - 30 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne

Scene 1: The royal court - Day

[Anil stands in the court. Meenakshi and Anita stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "What lovely weather!"

[Anil sits down on the throne.]

Meenakshi: "Okay, Anil."

[Anil drinks the poisoned wine and dies.]

Meenakshi: "We have to be strong now."
